WITH
  company_data AS (
    SELECT cn.id AS company_id, cn.country_code FROM company_name AS cn
    JOIN company_type AS ct ON cn.id = ct.company_id
    WHERE cn.country_code != '[us]' AND ct.kind IN ('movie', 'episode') AND ct.note NOT LIKE '%(USA)%' AND ct.note LIKE '%(200%)%'
  ),
  movie_info AS (
    SELECT mi.movie_id, mi.info AS country FROM movie_info AS mi
    WHERE mi.info IN ('Germany', 'German', 'USA', 'American') AND mi.info_type_id = it1.id
  ),
  rating_data AS (
    SELECT mi_idx.movie_id, mi_idx.info AS rating FROM movie_info_idx AS mi_idx
    WHERE mi_idx.info < '7.0' AND mi_idx.info_type_id = it2.id
  ),
  keyword_data AS (
    SELECT k.id AS keyword_id, k.keyword FROM keyword AS k
    WHERE k.keyword IN ('murder', 'murder-in-title', 'blood', 'violence')
  ),
  movie_keywords AS (
    SELECT mk.movie_id, k.keyword FROM movie_keyword AS mk
    JOIN keyword_data AS k ON mk.keyword_id = k.id
  ),
  title_data AS (
    SELECT t.id AS title_id, t.title, t.kind_id, t.production_year FROM title AS t
    JOIN movie_keywords AS mk ON t.id = mk.movie_id AND t.id = mk.title_id
    WHERE t.production_year > 2008 AND t.kind_id IN (SELECT kind_id FROM kind_type WHERE kind = 'movie')
  ),
  western_violent_movies AS (
    SELECT cd.company_id, rd.rating, td.title_id, MIN(td.title) AS western_violent_movie
    FROM company_data AS cd
    JOIN movie_info AS mi ON cd.company_id = mi.company_id
    JOIN rating_data AS rd ON mi.movie_id = rd.movie_id
    JOIN title_data AS td ON rd.movie_id = td.title_id
    WHERE td.title IN (SELECT title FROM title WHERE phonetic_code LIKE 'western%' AND production_year > 2008)
      AND td.title NOT IN (SELECT title FROM title WHERE phonetic_code LIKE 'cartoon%')
      AND rd.rating IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY cd.company_id, rd.rating, td.title_id
  )
SELECT wvm.movie_company AS movie_company, wvm.rating, MIN(td.title) AS western_violent_movie FROM western_violent_movies AS wvm
JOIN title_data AS td ON wvm.title_id = td.title_id
WHERE wvm.company_id IN (SELECT company_id FROM company_data)
GROUP BY wvm.movie_company, wvm.rating
